description: Validate a markdown document for PDF/UA-1 accessibility issues (heading hierarchy, missing alt text). Cheap — no rendering. Returns JSON { valid, issues: [{ severity, message, path, rule }], summary: { errors, warnings } }; `valid` is false when any issue has severity 'error'. Mirrors POST /api/v1/md/validate.

markdown.description: The GitHub-flavored markdown document to check, exactly as it would be passed to render_markdown. Up to 200KB of text; inline data: image payloads do not count toward that.

name: validate_markdown

issues.description: Every problem found, errors and warnings together.

message.description: What is wrong and, usually, how to fix it.

path.description: Location in the document tree (e.g. 'kids[0].kids[2]'); empty when it applies to the whole document.

rule.description: Identifier of the check that raised the issue.

valid.description: False when any issue has severity 'error'; warnings alone leave it true.

title: Validate markdown
